title: Release lore 0.9.0: version bump, CHANGELOG with the LCLI-565 rollout note
description: Prepares the first release carrying LCLI-565 (committed-schema generator stamp, lore check exit 7). User approved preparation 2026-09-22; publication (tag + release.yml publish:true) stays with the user. Follow docs/runbooks/release-publishing.md section 3 and the 0.8.0 bump commit 4d4a1bfb as the template. Version choice: 0.9.0 because exit 7 is a breaking CLI-contract change (ADR-0005). quest's latest is also 0.9.0 (published 2026-09-19); whether lore 0.9.0 + quest 0.9.0 is a qualified pair is opum-cli-e2e's to measure, and this release must not claim it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Registry checked first: @opum-ai/lore@0.9.0 is unclaimed, with a package-level read succeeding in the same check (an unreachable registry also returns E404)

Every version site moves to 0.9.0 in one commit, each named: package.json version and its six optionalDependencies pins, all six npm/<platform>/package.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, README generated version regions (shipped-readme-version.mjs --write then --check), bun.lock regenerated with the pinned Bun, and any derived digest sets the bump moves (benchmark/ladybug fixtures, pinned benchmarkDigest)

CHANGELOG 0.9.0 entry carries LCLI-565 AC[7] rollout note: exit 7 (indeterminate) is new and breaks consumers that freeze the taxonomy; the first stamping release makes every committed schema STALE (exit 6), not unattributable; consumers skip 0.8.0 and move their lore pin and run lore schema export in the SAME pull request (opum-agent OPAG-326); legitimate type removals now cost a hand rm; a lore release changing the digest projection or reserved coupling fields moves every repo at once
bun test, lint, typecheck and bun run lore check exit 0; the PR required checks are green on its head
Stops before any registry write: no tag push that publishes, no release.yml dispatch with publish:true -- those go to the user directly
